title_en: Battle at the a remote forest clearing
content_en:
The morning mist had barely lifted from a mist-shrouded mountain peak when Li Qiye arrived. His expression was calm, but those who knew him could see the faint gleam of anticipation in his eyes. Today was not an ordinary day.

He sat cross-legged on the cold stone and began to circulate his cultivation method. his sea of consciousness trembled as power flooded in. The crystal orb that showed fragments of the future hidden in his robes grew warm against his skin — a sign that something momentous was about to happen.

A crisp cracking sound echoed from his dantian — he had broken through! Li Qiye opened his eyes. The world looked different now — sharper, clearer, as if a veil had been lifted from his perception. He stood up slowly, testing his new strength.

A figure approached from the distance — demonic beast at the Foundation level. "I've been looking for you," the newcomer said, his voice cold. Li Qiye didn't flinch. He had been preparing for this moment for a long time.

He stepped forward, his palm glowing with condensed spiritual energy, and struck. The clash of spiritual energy sent ripples through the air. Spectators in the distance covered their eyes as the light grew blinding. When it faded, both figures were still standing — but only one was smiling.

Far away, on a mountain peak/spaceship/deck that no one had noticed until now, an old man/a woman/an AI watched the events unfold through a scrying orb/hologram/screen. "So it begins," he murmured. "The real test is yet to come."
